name: Fasnia (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over sky blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Fasnia (mountains above a sea and wheat on white and blue).
history: The flag was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands on 17 June 1998 as a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its width, composed of two horizontal stripes of equal size, red above in memory of the eruptions begun on 5 January 1705 whose lava flow created the volcanoes of Montaña Negra, and sky blue below in memory of the springing of the mountain waters, origin of the communities of Chifira and La Gambueza and of the progress of agriculture; if the flag bears the arms they are placed at the centre, preferably on both sides.
